wolfram.note: Series at Infinity is not implemented: ours stays the call. Wolfram is right, and its Indeterminate is the scan declining to compare a held series, not its answer: Series gives e^(-x) sqrt(pi/2) (x^(-1/2) - x^(-3/2)/8 + 9 x^(-5/2)/128 - 75 x^(-7/2)/1024), which agrees with mpmath besselk to 1e-7 at x = 30 and 8e-9 at x = 60.

Series at Infinity is not implemented: ours stays the call. Wolfram is right, and its Indeterminate is the scan declining to compare a held series, not its answer: Series gives e^(-x) sqrt(pi/2) (1/sqrt(x) + (4n^2 - 1)/(8 x^(3/2))), which agrees with mpmath besselk at n = 1/3 to 4e-5 at x = 30 and 1e-5 at x = 60 (and exactly at n = 3/2, where it terminates).
